verdict: SUCCESS — the canary did exactly its job: it validated the authoring mechanism end-to-end with a live model AND caught a real delivery-contract bug BEFORE the full 18-call run, and the hard stop correctly refused to run a trial whose suite was empty.

what_the_live_author_produced.quality: high — 4 red-before checks each covering a distinct convention (cap/dedupe/enum/prose) and 2 green-before regression guards (encoding, url). The author factored setup into two shared helper modules (_env.mjs harness, _jspdf_mock.mjs) that every check imports.

the_bug_the_canary_caught.symptom: AuthoringShortfall — no behavioural check admitted, so the trial was refused (correctly, by the hard stop).
the_bug_the_canary_caught.cause: collect_proposal captured only the files declared as a check's `script`. The author's two shared helpers (_env.mjs, _jspdf_mock.mjs) were NOT declared as checks, so they were dropped. Every check then died at admission on ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND importing ./_env.mjs — an error-red, never an assertion-red, so check_admission routed all six to suspicious-red and admitted none.
the_bug_the_canary_caught.proof_it_was_only_the_contract: Re-running admission with the helpers present (zero calls): all 6 admit — the 4 red-before fail on the baseline via ASSERTION (they discriminate), the 2 green-before pass. The author was right; my contract was wrong.
the_bug_the_canary_caught.not_a_safety_failure: The mechanism refused to spend the 2nd call on a trial with no working checks. A silent version would have run the loop against an empty suite and reported the score as the loop's — the exact defect that halted the campaign at 4/28. The hard stop is the feature working.

the_fix.collect_proposal: captures the WHOLE checks/ subtree — scripts AND their shared helpers — because a check's dependencies must travel with it.
the_fix.check_authoring.author: carries auxiliary (helper) files into result['files'], frozen from the first admitting round via setdefault so a re-author cannot silently swap a helper the earlier checks were admitted against.
the_fix.check_authoring.to_suite/merge: pins every auxiliary file into EVERY check's integrity list (_auxiliary_files), so tampering with a shared helper fails closed.
the_fix.install_checks: installs ALL suite files (checks + helpers) into the solution workspace, not only the declared scripts — the same drop, one step later, would have broken every check at loop-run time.
the_fix.brief: now tells the author that helper modules must also live under checks/ and import by relative path.
the_fix.regression_test: tests/test_author_role.py::SharedHelper — a check importing a helper must admit, install and verify-pin; pins the exact defect at zero calls.

deferred_proof_now_concrete.claim: arm_validity returns 'authored-at-run-time' for an authoring arm and explicitly does NOT prove discrimination itself — it defers to check_admission + the runner hard stop. This canary makes that proof concrete on a REAL live-authored suite.
deferred_proof_now_concrete.method: reconstruct the merged suite from the real canary author reply through the FIXED collect_proposal + author_into (zero calls), materialize the fixture's before/after variants, INSTALL the authored checks+helpers into each, run the suite.

result.before_historical_bug: RED on citation-cap, citation-dedup, enum-markers, long-prose-split (the 2 guards green)
result.conclusion: the live-authored suite DISCRIMINATES: red on the historical bug, green on the shipped fix

deferred_proof_now_concrete.probe_artifact_warning: arm_validity.probe_suite run directly on this suite first reported 'over-constrained' — an ARTIFACT: probe_suite does not install workspace-relative authored scripts into its before/after workspaces, so every check failed 'script missing' on both sides. Real for authored suites, harmless for the campaign (arm_validity never probes authored suites — it returns authored-at-run-time). Corrected the probe by installing the scripts; the real verdict is 'discriminates'.

spend_status.breakdown: 4 on the halted invalid-design campaign + 1 author call here

Recommend one more bounded 2-call authoring canary to see the full path green with a fresh author, THEN release the remaining ceiling.
